notes.title: World Wide Hack UPDATE 0.9.4
notes.content:
This update we have just released is the first of one of two big releases, which will bring much more content into the game.

The first one [b]focuses mainly on new players[/b] who are learning how to use the terminal, go through puzzles, and play World Wide Hack. We have made changes which should help more players to go successfully through the training. 

The second part of the release contains lots of new mechanics and content in preparation for the next big release [b]focused on endgame and PvP[/b]. You can expect huge tool balancing update, regular control fights over some critical NPC nodes, and better support for custom-created web services and scripts.

We are also doing streams every Wednesday on [url=https://discord.gg/Mpy9hbR]Discord[/url] and this week for the first time on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1765690/view/3091165066128997965]Steam[/url] as part of SIMFEST. 

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[h3]New content and improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Demo improvements and changes
 [*] > removed last Demo puzzle
 [*] > disabled "unhacked" version
 [*] > changed initial game screen
 [*] > added command hints to all tutorial steps showed after multiple incorrect tries
 [*] > updated tutorial texts
[*] added Pixelart related Kickstarter rewards
[*] added ranking of players and groups for both faction and non[*]faction gameplay
[*] extended manuals with details about scripting, web creation, and unique webs
[*] added the first two special NPC servers scripts: bank and court server, both with unique content
[*] added endgame mechanic allowing regular fights for control of each special nodes
[*] prepared list of special NPC servers on search.web domain
[*] reworked tools description, so it is now generated automatically
[*] added switching between users
[*] modified chat behavior and formatting so it is better readable based on sender/group
[*] changed default OS commands vs. bin tools
[*] added requirement of essential bin tools for other tools
[*] some libraries now extend build-in commands (don't require downloading tool)
[*] much more tools now support scripting
[*] added special scripting commands
[*] extended chat groups commands
[*] changed behavior of upload/download for licensed tools
[*] added cp (copy) command 
[*] sniffer now can run from any OS version
[*] database now respects set disk permissions
[*] many preparations for the upcoming big tool balancing release
[*] NPCs now respond to node hackers based on the scale of changes and have more complex (realistic) behavior
[*] added a new hosting option
[*] modified system rights restrictions for root
[*] added a new exploitable OS bug
[*] other smaller improvements
[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] fixed downloading data using a browser
[*] fixed OS version bugs 
[*] fixed tracer behavior
[*] fixed mining on remote nodes
[*] lot of fixes in scripting
[*] fixes in sound settings and soundtrack playback
[*] other minor fixes
[/list]

notes.title: World Wide Hack UPDATE 0.9.3
notes.content:
The next update is here and we bring to you [b]lots of new content[/b] we manage to test and prepare for you. You can now play in the game [u][b]3 new quests with over 15 tools[/b][/u] used the first time in quests.
Some of the quests are now also [u][b]fully Co-op / PvP[/b][/u]. This means that the deeper in the network you get, the higher the chance of encountering other players on the same quest [i](you are notified so you can still choose to abort the quest if preferring solo)[/i].

Thanks to our Discord community for their effort in testing, providing inputs, and feedback. World Wide Hack is becoming more stable and even more fun thanks to you! [i](Still not joined [url=https://discord.gg/Mpy9hbR]Discord[/url]?)[/i]

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[h3]New content:[/h3]
[list]
[*] added 3 new level-3 quests
[*] proper quest PvP/coop added - task in the permanent network are now shared between players (for same and different factions)
[*] qtwork current now displays the number of players on quest and nicknames of players of the same faction
[*] extended dbclient with more request functions
[*] added commands ip, rmdir and nmap2
[*] added option to hide terminal animation
[*] added sorting of tools by OS in market
[*] added option for streamers to hide their IP
[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes &  Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] lots of small text fixes 
[*] text improvements for better understanding of Demo part, quests and some tools
[*] improvements of displaying terminal content
[*] added option to hide terminal animation 
[*] fixed most of the bugs of tools and exploits mainly of level 3 and lower
[*] fix in settings miner's IP
[*] mv, upload, and download now using the current path
[*] virus_sys_lock temporary disabled
[*] major changes in node disk usage and disk tool
[*] custom quest tools now display success/fail 
[*] fixed security problems in prot4+  
[*] added more security actions to NPC behavior
[*] lots of quest fixes
[*] fixed sys.log logging
[*] added scroll in map using mouswheel
[/list]

notes.title: World Wide Hack UPDATE 0.9.2
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that the [b]Linux version is now available[/b] also with the Windows version and web version.

We have also done a huge rework of some core system mechanics regarding rights and commends execution, mainly as preparation for more complex tools of higher levels. 

Now lets see [u]the Changelog:[/u]
[list]
[*] available Linux desktop version (tested on Ubuntu)
[*] added special frame reward (Kickstarter and Patreon supporters)
[*] added status window on the login screen with server / game status
[*] added community tool for submitting text changes (contact admins for access)
[*] reworked system behavior while using other tools to access other nodes (browser, scripts, coin, some exploits...)
[*] reworked rights system (players are now protected same ways as NPCs based on OS version until they edit rights)
[*] some exploits are now dependent on root user rights
[*] added special rights for area servers (now rights are dependent on the level and if it is owned by the player, or its router or special node)
[*] user now cannot remove connection and rights management permission from the currently connected user
[*] format commands rights requirements updated
[*] preparing for better support of coin system for scripting
[*] added path format checking
[*] moved check of ownership of game copy right before multiplayer starts
[*] small performance improvements
[*] after the player leaves simulation, his whole subnet gets reset (ready for next player)
[*] NPCnodes are now kept a little more similar between quests
[*] improved system for cheating recognition
[/list]

[u]Bugfixes:[/u]
[list]
[*] fixed problems with promotion
[*] added more simple restart of training and quests
[*] fixed and improved some text (hints, assignment..) problems
[*] fixed some steps in quests which should not repeat
[*] fixed wrong OS version on maintenance OS bug
[*] multiple problems with rights system fixed
[*] multiple problems with miner fixed
[*] some coin system bugs fixed
[*] upgrade / downgrade of OS made more clear
[*] hostname tools fixed
[*] qtwork tool fixes (who, repeat, restart..) 
[*] more small fixes
[*] fixed multiple case-sensitivity issues
[*] different services execution at same time disabled (fix)
[*] fixed nodes losing visibility in the network over time
[*] fixed bug with the wrong recipient in the chat window
[/list]

notes.title: World Wide Hack UPDATE 0.9.1
notes.content:
[b]We have been working last days very intensively to fix and improve the most critical problems you have reported us or suggested to improve.[/b] It has been done in multiple small Hotfix releases on the server side so you don't have to wait for bigger updates like this one.

We would like to thank you all for your feedback, testing, and trying how far you can push game borders, it was intensive for us, but fun! And we cannot believe how this community came to life after release. We are really happy we get all this positive feedback and also thankful for your patience and understanding time requirements on these bug fixes.

If you didn't join our community and want a more intensive social experience of the game, for sure join our Discord: https://discord.gg/Mpy9hbR

[i]Also if you didn't buy the game yet or want one more copy for your friend, look on the #sharing-competition channel on Discord and how to get your free copy until the end of the year![/i]

We have created a public board of tasks we are working on. Currently created mainly for holding bug fixes. Later will be also modified to hold all of our confirmed plans for features and improvements: https://trello.com/b/qmx9zeF6/world-wide-hack

We will continue next week working on some new critical reports and other Major ones.
 
[h3]Now let's see what has been changed and fixed:[/h3]
[u]In Hotfixes released earlier:[/u]
- fixing problem with retrieving Steam key with Kickstarter access key while the account is deactivated
- fixing problem with FTP in training (please delete training in NETWORK and start it again) and multiplayer (if you had a problem - have a nickname with uppercase - remove keys you have in /home folder and use "qtwork access" to regenerate them)
- small fixes on exploits manipulating files
- fixed netstat
- fixed adding players to chat groups
- fixed wrong behavior of chat outside the simulation
- fixing chat2 problem
- fixing problems related to training finish / node deletion
- fixed problem with FTP - actually permissions generation problem
- fixed repeating assignment 
- blocked creation of multiple servers
- fixed problem when running both jail and prot
- fixed major bug with generating training and quests (missing assignment or unable to generate training) 
> training - just delete and start training again in NETWORK
> quest - use qtwork abort and request quest again (if abort get stuck, PM me)
- fixed dictattack weird behavior on upper prots
- minor fixes on texts and node rights

[u]In the current update:[/u]
- download command problem with the target directory 
- stuck bug reporting in terminal
- disabled rights.conf download/upload to prevent self-locking players our
- disabled upper reputation limit for EARLY ACCESS duration (so you can replay quest multiple times)
- fixes assignment in Milgram experiment task
- fixed at least two major causes of tasks autocompletion
- some fixes in text and triggers in training
- fixed quest document in Limited asset task
- fixed crash on some atypical inputs
- added dbclient as an installable tool
- fix rights on executing files and formating
- fixed system parameters of routers
- added remove logs trojan detection in shield
- other small fixes which make game more stable

notes.title: World Wide Hack is on Steam NOW!
notes.content:
[b]We have launched World Wide Hack in Early Access after over 4 years of hard work![/b]

It was a long, exciting, and hard journey and it does not end here. We are moving forward with you towards simulations of worlds with more and more hackers, protectors, and freelancers, everyone with his own goals in this computer network universe. We can't wait to see these networks get alive with your hacking activities, cooperation, fights, creations, and exploration.

[h3]Early Access release state[/h3]
After lots of testing and debugging, we delivered you relatively stable training (single player part) and the first 2 (of 5) levels in the multiplayer part of the game. We will continue in the testing process and gradually release next quests and content after our testing interactions probably regularly on monthly basis. We decided to leave all tools in-game even though some of them, which are not needed for finishing released quests, contain some problems you can encounter. We will fix and improve them also in those regular releases together with quests in which they are used.

[h3]What to expect next[/h3]
During the next few days, we will gather mainly reports of some critical problems and needed improvements and if needed, we will try to release them by end of this year. Our next step will be adding support for Linux (Ubuntu and probably runnable on Fedora and Debian).

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello World![/h2]
Release in Early Access is here, so save this date - [b]Wednesday the 22th of December[/b] - in your calendar and be ready to spend some of your holiday's free time in the hacking simulation world! And [i]please share[/i] this with your friends and anyone who could be interested

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281658/ee55ac93c423b697d06b5bfcd0fdd61117889d8a.jpg[/img]

[h2]Big milestone[/h2]
We started this journey 4 years ago, and we are finally there - ready to involve you in our future steps during the next development in Early Access. We are at a significant milestone, but it does not end here. We hope to grow our community much bigger and enjoy the game even more while getting to the finish line.

[h2]Plans[/h2]
We will add Windows support (next to our Web version) on this release. As promised, we are still planning to add other platforms during the following months. We will also announce a more detailed timeline of what we would like to accomplish during this Early Access unit we finish Beta. You - our community - will also be involved in decisions about this plan.

tags.feature: We will add Windows support (next to our Web version) on this release.
